guitar.notes: James Williamson (Stooges) is known for playing a Gibson Les Paul Custom; Ron Asheton also played guitar on earlier Stooges material. Solo Iggy Pop has used various backing guitarists, so kept at medium.

tone.target: dry mid-gain garage rock crunch with slight fuzz bite
tone.profile: dry mid-gain garage rock crunch with slight fuzz bite
tone.summary: A compact, punchy garage rock tone achieved using a Blues OD for grit, followed by an AC30 TB to capture the Plexi/Marshall edge, finished with minimal reverb and EQ shaping.
corrections: keep fuzz subtle, not full fuzz

rig.name: Iggy Pop - The Passenger - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Provide the initial mid-gain crunch and slight fuzz bite.

alternatives.reason: Similar tone, but Blues OD is better for garage rock grit.

blocks.purpose: Add subtle fuzz texture without sounding muddy or overly saturated.
blocks.gap: The Red Haze is used subtly (low drive) to provide the required 'fuzz bite' without becoming a full fuzz tone, fulfilling the 'slight fuzz texture' requirement.

alternatives.reason: Too aggressive for this specific track.

blocks.purpose: Emulate the Plexi/Marshall edge and provide a punchy, mid-focused British tone.

alternatives.reason: Good alternative, but AC30 TB is more associated with the desired 'Plexi' sound.

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary punch.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative, but UK Vintage 4x12 is the standard choice for this genre.

blocks.purpose: Boost the mid-range bite and tighten up the low end to achieve 'mid bite' and 'firm bass'.
Kept inactive as per 'drop wah' correction.
Disabled to avoid 'big chorus' and maintain a dry sound.
Add minimal space and dimension without sounding 'lush' or overly wet.
blocks.gap: The Room reverb is used sparingly (low mix) to provide a subtle sense of depth, avoiding the 'lush reverb' trap.

alternatives.reason: Can sometimes sound too bright or artificial for garage rock.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to enhance mid-range bite and dry close-mic feel.

proposals.reason: Enhance the desired 'dry close-mic' punch and mid-focus.
